optimize_global_scene_alignment: optimize a global 3D scene by aligning pairwise image observations using the BasePCOptimizer class
compute_global_alignment_with_init: compute global alignment of a scene graph using minimum spanning tree or known poses initialization
clean_pointcloud_remove_outliers: clean a 3D pointcloud by removing outliers and lowering confidence of points in front of depthmaps
visualize_scene_with_cameras: visualize the optimized 3D scene with camera poses and pointclouds using the show method
run_global_alignment_loop: run the global alignment optimization loop with configurable learning rate schedule and iteration count
